conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with lower volatility. Expect modest returns around 1.5% per month. The primary risk is missing out on potential upside if the market rallies strongly.

Reduce exposure in leveraged AI/Software (METU, PLTU, MSFU) and weak semis (MUU).

balanced.read: This balanced plan seeks risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% per month. It reduces concentration and leverage while adding a high-quality setup. The main risk is that market volatility could still impact returns despite de-risking efforts.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for amplified gains.
Boost positions in leveraged AI/Software (METU, PLTU, MSFU) and semis (MUU).
Add a high-conviction scanner setup like AMZN.

Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretched growth, targeting around 4% per month, by leaning into leverage and concentration. The risk is substantially higher, with potential for large, rapid drawdowns amplified by leveraged ETFs and margin. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can also impact performance.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta tech/semis (CRWD, SMH, SNOW, SMCI).
Increase allocation to QQQI for enhanced income generation.
Focus shifts entirely to generating steady monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes income and low drawdown over growth.

income.read: This income-focused plan aims for steady monthly distributions around 1% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. The risk is that market downturns can still reduce the Net Asset Value (NAV) of holdings, and distributions are not guaranteed. It sacrifices growth potential for income stability.
